items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: So I went down and got all these guys together and they all joined my band. And Don Byas was an alto player and I put him on tenor.

ctx.x: This is '36. And I had -- in fact Don Byas and Jack McVea and -- in fact, these fellows were all playing at Billy Papke's with a band named Charlie Echolls. So I went down and got all these guys together and they all joined my band. And Don Byas was an alto player and I put him on tenor. That's when he started -- he never did play alto again. I put him on tenor. And I used to sit with him and work with mouthpieces because when he first got the tenor
it was a little bit too much for him to play. And he became one of the giant tenor players of all times to my knowing, because he played with me again back in New York.
